hero.title: Advancing on-chain AI inference.
subtitle: Open R&D on running fully autonomous AI agents on a public blockchain.
No off-chain shortcuts. Verifiable by design.

phrases.text: You are what you know and remember.
Lose that, and you lose yourself.
Expertise means nothing if the agent has to relearn you every time.
Without memory, without context, without a relationship to your reality, it’s just noise.
The question isn’t whether AI is powerful. It’s whether your agent actually knows you.

problem.title: No one actually runs AI on-chain.
problem.lead: Every project that claims to have an <s>“on-chain AI agent”</s> follows the same pattern : inference runs off-chain, on centralized servers, and only the result is posted to the blockchain. The model never executes inside the network. The chain is used as a bulletin board, not as a compute layer.
problem.leadStrong: That is not an on-chain agent. That is an API call with a receipt.

steps.title: The claim
steps.body: “AI-powered on-chain agent.” Inference happens on AWS. The chain only stores the output.

steps.title: The gap
steps.body: No verifiable execution. No deterministic replay. No way to audit what the model actually computed.

steps.title: Our approach
steps.body: Full inference inside the canister. WASM SIMD, on the Swiss Subnet. Verifiable, reproducible, truly on-chain.

problem.closing: We have already demonstrated this. <s>Origyn</s> runs real inference on-chain today. We are now in an active testing phase, stress-testing robustness across models and workloads to confirm what our benchmarks already show : this is the most reliable <s>on-chain AI</s> inference stack that exists.

agent.title: Origyn. Minimal agent, maximal memory.
agent.lead: A sovereign AI agent running on-chain. Its first mission: the Sovereign Second Brain. A small model fed by decades of your structured context, certified on the Swiss blockchain. Not a giant model on-chain. A focused agent with a certified vault.

cards.title: User side
cards.subtitle: Local Bureau
cards.body: The user’s machine. Large language models, private files, offline work. Your intelligence stays with you.

cards.title: Blockchain side
cards.subtitle: On-Chain Vault
cards.body: The canister. Certified vault, verifiable inference, deterministic replay. Your context becomes provable infrastructure.

vault.title: Certified by construction.
vault.lead: Every fragility addressed at the root. Not a promise. A protocol.

cards.title: Legal proof of existence
cards.body: Blockchain-certified timestamping. Admissible in court, no notary required.

cards.title: Full provenance
cards.body: Who created, modified, certified each document. Immutable traceability chain.

cards.title: Versioning
cards.body: Every version preserved. Roll back at any time.

cards.title: Controlled sharing
cards.body: Read-only, time-limited, revocable in one click. Works even when offline.

cards.title: Dead man’s switch
cards.body: Designated heirs automatically recover access after a defined period of inactivity.

cards.title: Immutable audit trail
cards.body: Who saw what, when, why. Full regulatory compliance built in.

cards.title: 24/7 monitoring
cards.body: The canister runs even when your PC is off. Automatic alerts for anomalies.

cards.title: Certified assets
cards.body: Tokenized gold, real estate, collectibles. Provenance certificates alongside cognitive patrimony.

results.title: Faster than the existing.
results.lead: Same models, same conditions, production network. Our custom WASM SIMD kernels make the difference.
results.body1: For the same compute budget, a Second Brain powered by our fork does three times more work, or consumes three times fewer resources.
body2: We are not tied to any single model or architecture. Every new release is an opportunity.
We continuously benchmark and integrate the latest models to push speed, accuracy, and efficiency further.

cards.title: Fleet of micro-experts
cards.body: Instead of one slow large model, we deploy task-specific finetuned sub-1B parameter models: sorting emails, classifying documents, evaluating risk. Faster and more precise than a generalist.

cards.title: On-chain distillation
cards.body: A large model teaches off-chain, a small model deploys on-chain. Combined with 4-bit quantization and our custom WASM SIMD kernels, this enables real AI within a canister’s instruction budget.
